同时显示的批注文字过多，请缩短文字或拆分批注时间后再导出。: Too much annotation text is visible at once. Shorten the text or separate the annotations in time before exporting.
用此长度标定同一帧的所有标尺: Use this length to calibrate all rulers on this frame
距离必须大于零: Distance must be greater than zero
录制前显示所选设备电平；录制中显示实际采集电平（已计入增益和静音）: Before recording, meters show the selected devices. During recording, they show the captured levels after gain and mute.
临时录屏：切换视频或退出后会清理。要保留视频和批注，请导出审阅包。: Temporary recording. Export a review package to keep the video and annotations before switching videos or exiting.
无法解码审阅预览。可使用 VLC 播放原片。: Cannot decode the review preview. Open the original video in VLC.
点击终点或拖至终点松手: Click the endpoint or drag to it and release
点击第二条边的端点: Click the endpoint of the second arm
移动鼠标预览长度，点击终点固定标尺: Move the pointer to preview the length, then click to finish
依次点击第一条边端点、顶点、第二条边端点: Click the first endpoint, the vertex, then the second endpoint
依次点击标尺起点和终点，或按住并拖动: Click the start and end points, or drag between them
拖出文字框，内容使用当前批注文字: Drag a text box to place the current annotation text
框选要放大的内容，松开后可分别拖动取景框和放大预览: Select the area to magnify, then drag the source and preview separately
在画面上按住并拖动以绘制标记: Drag on the canvas to draw
请输入大于零的已知长度，并拉开标尺两端。: Enter a known length greater than zero and move the ruler endpoints apart.
请确认角度在 0° 到 180° 之间，并将顶点或重合的端点移开后重试。: Enter an angle from 0° to 180° and move any overlapping points apart.
本审阅已达到 10000 条批注上限。: This review has reached the 10,000-annotation limit.
本审阅的批注编号已用尽。: No more annotation numbers are available for this review.
未能写入剪贴板，请重试。: Could not write to the clipboard. Try again.
· 拖动两端调整批注时长: · Drag the edges to change the duration
选择绘图工具，或右键画面新增批注。: Select a drawing tool or right-click the canvas to add an annotation.
请等当前帧显示后再捕获。: Wait for the current frame to appear before capturing it.
终点必须晚于起点。: The end must be later than the start.
批注及关联语音必须位于时间线内。: The annotation and its linked audio must fit within the timeline.
时长须在 0 与剩余视频时长之间。: The duration must be between zero and the remaining video length.
语音批注的时长由录音决定。: The recording determines the duration of a voice annotation.
片段必须保留正时长。: The clip duration must be greater than zero.
时间线或片段数量超出限制。: The timeline or clip count exceeds the limit.
不能超出原始素材范围或移动到时间线起点之前。: Clips must stay within the source media and cannot start before zero.
联动批注不能移到时间线起点之前。: Linked annotations cannot start before zero.
片段发生重叠，请先移到空白处或吸附到相邻边缘。: Clips overlap. Move to an empty space or snap to an adjacent edge.
剪辑已更新 · 删除保留空隙: Edit applied · Deleting leaves a gap
{0} {1} – {2} · 拖动移动，两端裁剪: {0} {1} – {2} · Drag to move or drag either edge to trim
· 拖过另一片段的中点可换序: · Drag past another clip’s midpoint to reorder
请先保存当前图片批注。: Save the current image annotation first.
无法按原图分辨率生成 PNG。: Cannot render a PNG at the original resolution.
请选择 PNG、JPEG、WebP 或 BMP 图片。: Select a PNG, JPEG, WebP, or BMP image.
请选择小于 32 MB 的图片。: Select an image smaller than 32 MB.
每条批注最多可添加 16 张图片。: Each annotation supports up to 16 images.
拖动图片移动位置，拖动角点等比缩放。: Drag the image to move it. Drag a corner to resize proportionally.
设置区间出点并添加批注: Set the out point and add a region
将片段开头贴到同轨上一片段结尾，首段移到零点: Align the clip start with the previous clip on this track, or move the first clip to zero
将片段结尾贴到同轨下一片段开头，末段贴到时间线末尾: Align the clip end with the next clip on this track, or move the last clip to the timeline end
打开视频、图片或审阅包: Open a video, image or review package
查看剪贴板图片: to view an image from the clipboard
请在左侧「音频捕获」中移除或重新连接已断开的设备: Remove or reconnect disconnected devices under Audio capture
请在左侧「音频捕获」中启用至少一路声音: Enable at least one source under Audio capture
录音中 · 视频同步播放，点击停止: Recording with video playback · Click to stop
语音批注已保存，播放视频时同步回放。: Voice annotation saved. It will play in sync with the video.
未标定的标尺按 96 px 等于 25.4 mm 换算。: Uncalibrated rulers use 96 px per 25.4 mm.
点击前往 GitHub Issues 界面提交问题。: Open GitHub Issues to report a problem.
单击安装脚本或发送到当前 REAPER 工程；拖到轨道以选择插入位置: Click to install the script or send to the current REAPER project. Drag onto a track to choose the insertion point
在表头显示源文件名: Show the source filename above the columns
画面预览嵌入工作簿。含语音批注或导入音频批注的片段链接到 MP4，其余区间链接到: Previews are embedded in the workbook. Segments with recorded or imported annotation audio link to MP4. Other regions link to GIF and ordinary marks link to PNG.
将工作簿和所选媒体一起打包。接收方解压后即可打开表格中的媒体链接。: Bundle the workbook and selected media together. Extract the archive to open media links from the workbook.
请至少选择一列导出。: Select at least one column to export.
打开视频、图片或审阅包，或按 Ctrl+V 查看剪贴板图片。: Open a video, image or review package, or press Ctrl+V to view an image from the clipboard.
设置区间出点并添加批注（O）: Set out point and add region (O)
按起始时间排列编号，仅更改批注编号: Change only annotation numbers, in start-time order
显示或隐藏画面中的常驻批注编号: Show or hide persistent note numbers on the canvas
选中一条批注即可查看和编辑。: Select an annotation to view and edit it.
保存后，下次启动 FrameNote 或 Player 时生效。: Save to apply this language the next time you open FrameNote or Player.
